item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We know what is at stake: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, everyone on Earth will die. We refuse to accept that future. Stopping its development must be a global priority.

2. We will not trade humanity’s future for superintelligent AI. If it is built within the next 20 years, everyone on Earth will die. No promise of profit, progress or power justifies that outcome. We must stop it.

3. We want a future in which our children grow up and humanity survives. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, everyone on Earth will die. We are organising to prevent its development. Join us.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We hold a clear position: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, everyone on Earth will die. We refuse to treat human extinction as an acceptable price for technological ambition. We are working to stop this development because everything we cherish depends on humanity surviving: our families, our communities, our cultures and the generations still to come. We demand that governments make preventing superintelligent AI a priority, and we reject the idea that competition or profit can justify proceeding. We have a responsibility to act while there is still time. Together, we must turn that responsibility into organised public pressure and binding limits.
